## Review result: incomplete—event evidence unavailable

I confirmed the relevant work order and Pending Close timestamp, but **cannot determine whether a cost event was created afterward** from the accessible records.

| Requested item | Finding |
|---|---|
| Manufacturing/work order | **MO-25-09-1070** |
| Internal work-order ID | **WO-2025-09-004** |
| Operation/product | Modine Racine–Dekoven; Cooler Plate Pack |
| Cost period | **Sep-25 — PER-COST-2025-09** |
| Exact Pending Close time | **2025-09-30T18:00:00** |
| Source transaction | Not verifiable |
| Event amount | Not verifiable |
| Exact event-created time | Not verifiable |
| Lateness | Cannot calculate without the event-created timestamp |
| Recorded accounting status | Not verifiable |
| Status consistent with Oracle policy? | Cannot conclude without the event type, timestamp, and status |

The supplied timestamp has no timezone offset, so I have not assumed one. The accessible task records contain **no cost-event rows**, and the supporting-record service returned **“supporting records not staged.”** This is an evidence gap—not evidence that no late event occurred.

### Applicable Oracle treatment

Oracle Fusion Cloud SCM Cost Management 26B states that new transactions falling in or before a period in **Pending Close** are not staged in Cost Accounting or Receipt Accounting; they are processed after the period is closed or reopened. Transactions entered before Pending Close continue to process. **Revenue lines, COGS recognition, and manual cost adjustments are exceptions** that continue processing.

*Source: “Cost Accounting Period Statuses and Transaction Accounting,” PDF page 233 / printed page 225.*

To complete the conclusion, an authorized records custodian must provide the cost-event rows for **WO-2025-09-004**, including transaction ID, event type, amount, creation time, and accounting status.

**No database records were changed.** The incomplete report was submitted with status **needs_evidence**, and the audit result and provenance were saved to `/cache/work/worker_da2c22f2570f/audit-report.json`.
